meaning:
ἀκαιρέομαι, -οῦμαι
(ἄκαιρος, unseasonable),
to have no opportunity (opposite to εὐκαιρέω): Php.4:10.†
(AS)
glosses: had no opportunity to show it

renderings.bsb: you had no opportunity to show it

elsewhere.note: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly, that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.
